_notice: DEMO VALUES. Every threshold, duration, weight and schedule below is a demonstration placeholder, NOT a clinical recommendation. The medical team owns and must set these values.

supplement.label: B-vitamin supplement (folate, B6, B12, riboflavin)
supplement.source: NASA B-vitamin study protocol: one pill per day, from ~6 months before flight to 30 days after landing

THIGH_CUFF.label: Veno-constrictive thigh cuffs
THIGH_CUFF.source: NASA Thigh Cuff study: 2 sessions of 6 hours with leg and neck vein ultrasound

LBNP.label: Lower body negative pressure
LBNP.source: Tested in the NASA Fluid Shifts study; session parameters here are demo values

safetySignals.label: Pain in an arm or leg
Swelling of an arm or leg
Redness or warmth of an arm or leg
Swelling or discomfort in the neck
Any other new or unusual symptom

RETINA_DELTA_UM.label: Total retinal thickness change vs baseline

risk.disclaimer: Indicative score for prioritising follow-up. Built on simulated data. Not clinically validated.

returnProtocol: Return-to-Earth measures (for example graded compression garments or fluid loading) are defined by the flight surgeon. This app only displays the plan the medical team has entered.

radio.label: Time-compressed demo: a real pass might be ~8 min every ~90 min

vitals._notice: Live vitals thresholds are demo values.
